card.name: Multiplication sign in dose formulas
card.fires_on: The last digit or bracket just before a multiplication sign (x or ×) in a dosing formula. It is mostly the 5 of 0.85 in the female creatinine clearance correction.

modes.label: Female correction factor
modes.description: The 5 of 0.85 right before × in the Cockcroft-Gault female adjustment.

modes.label: Dose calculation formulas
modes.description: A closing bracket or word right before x in a weight-based or percentage dose formula.
modes.example: Total dose (mcg) = patient’s weight (kg<<)>> x prescribed dose (mcg/kg).
